entries.description: A list of aggregated click entries, showing unique clicks per subscriber with click statistics

email.description: Email address of the subscriber who clicked the broadcast. *Note:* This is the current email address of the subscriber, not necessarily the email address the broadcast was sent to.

event_time.description: Time when the first click occurred for this subscriber

resource_type_link.description: A link to the click type

subscriber_link.description: The link to the subscriber entry

first_click_at.description: Time of the first click by this subscriber

last_click_at.description: Time of the last click by this subscriber

total_clicks.description: Total number of clicks by this subscriber

next_collection_link.description: A link to the next page of entries if more entries exist. This attribute is omitted from the collection if there are no more entries.

prev_collection_link.description: A link to the previous page of entries if any exist.

resource_type_link.description: A link that identifies the type of resource that this collection represents

total_size.description: The total number of unique subscribers who clicked the broadcast

entries.description: A list of individual click event entries, showing each click occurrence with the specific URL

email.description: Email address of the subscriber who clicked the broadcast. *Note:* This is the current email address of the subscriber, not necessarily the email address the broadcast was sent to.

event_time.description: Time when this individual click event occurred (same value as clicked_at)

resource_type_link.description: A link to the click type

subscriber_link.description: The link to the subscriber entry

clicked_at.description: Timestamp of when this specific click occurred

next_collection_link.description: A link to the next page of entries if more entries exist. This attribute is omitted from the collection if there are no more entries.

prev_collection_link.description: A link to the previous page of entries if any exist.

resource_type_link.description: A link that identifies the type of resource that this collection represents

total_size.description: The total number of individual click events (can be higher than unique subscribers if some clicked multiple times)
